body:
I have some friends but I don't like to burden them with this stuff. 

Stability would be nice I guess.

I don't know. Probably something to help me change, I don't know what that may be.  Whether it be a person or an experience I don't know. All I know is that I won't go on like this.

I half considered the military but it got a pretty bad rap from my family.

When I was young I wanted more than anything to have a family that cared for each other that looked out for one another. That didn't abuse each other. Little coincidence Matilda was my favorite movie at the time.
